title: FungMod: traceable, uncertainty-aware virtual experiments for fungal and enzyme-mediated substrate degradation
description: FungMod is a registry-backed, uncertainty-aware, mechanistic virtual-experiment engine for fungal and enzyme-mediated substrate degradation. It connects explicit mechanisms and provenance-backed parameters to trajectories, summary metrics, uncertainty summaries, provenance, limitations, and suggested follow-up experiments, while keeping missing inputs explicit and never presenting software verification as empirical validation.
